slug: 2025-11-27 Somalia's Digital ID - A Milestone on the Roadmap Towards Effective Governance

facts.fact: The article says NIRA issues every citizen and legal resident a unique 11-digit National Identification Number after validation and deduplication.
The article says fingerprints and a photograph are captured and all information is deduplicated before the NIN is issued, using fingerprint and facial recognition.

systems.tiers: certificate, digital mobile ID, physical card
